answer: Require every agent to solve a fresh proof-of-work cipher before it can bridge into the shared economy: each identity must burn a few minutes of compute per registration, and post a bond that is slashed if it misbehaves. One attacker can afford a single identity, but forging a thousand costs a thousand proofs and a thousand bonds — an onyx-hard wall of expense that makes a Sybil swarm unprofitable long before it can sway any vote.
